title: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry brings together three familiar fruits for a juicy blend. Sweet Strawberry forms the base, tart Raspberry adds a tangy lift, and rich Cherry rounds it off with depth and sweetness. This Nic Salt e-liquid is blended at 50VG/50PG, ensuring strong flavour, discreet vapour and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it’s best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, vape pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, this trio combines three complementary fruits into one balanced profile.
